title: Interior Trim Glare and Trim Fit Issues
summary: Feedback in this topic centers mainly on interior trim and dash surfaces causing sunlight glare, with a smaller set of fragments mentioning trim appearance preferences or unclear fitment issues.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the black shadowline trim for its appearance.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mainly describe reflective dash or console trim that throws distracting or blinding sunlight, with a few additional complaints about distracting lighting and loose or missing trim pieces.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention trim style preferences and possible misalignment or fitment concerns, but the examples are too brief or descriptive to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: Several undetermined fragments are too short or lack clear evaluative language to support a firmer sentiment classification.
This cluster includes both interior glare complaints and some separate trim fitment or exterior trim references, so it is not fully uniform in subject matter.
One sampled negative-assigned example has undetermined fragment sentiment, so the fragment text itself is less clear than the assigned review-level label.
